scope: India/Bay of Bengal feasibility; ranges are working planning bands unless marked branch-fixed
method_notes: Do not restore every historical Solomon loss automatically; Santo/New Caledonia substitute losses remain.
No historical Guadalcanal/Tokyo-Express attrition chain exists in this branch.
Fleet destroyers are not default cargo trucks; coast-defense/escort categories increasingly separate roles.
First-line carriers are not allocated to India central plan as of Sep 1943.

major_surface.india_use: Old BB pair (Fuso/Yamashiro or Ise/Hyuga) is the first bombardment candidate; Kongo-class remains higher-value Pacific/fast-force asset unless Eastern Fleet reaction demands escalation.

fleet_destroyers.note: ranges require future individual-hull ledger closure; central concept is much healthier than historical Solomon attrition, not loss-free

escort_separation.dedicated_kaibokan_mid_1943: roughly 10-16 working band, rapidly increasing later in 1943
escort_separation.effect: routine low-speed convoy escort increasingly moves off fleet DDs; not complete separation yet

submarines.branch_difference: roughly +4 to +6 nominal boats vs historical state at late spring/early summer; effective patrol capacity materially higher
submarines.india_operation_candidate: 8-12 total including existing Indian Ocean allocation and temporary reinforcement
submarines.rule: do not convert Cox's sustainment into submarine cargo traffic

specialized_landing_shipping.shinshu_maru: repairing during summer; Sep-Oct return is a future gate, not current guaranteed availability
specialized_landing_shipping.nisshin: high branch-survival candidate because historical New Georgia loss event is absent; individual survival must still be ledger-checked
specialized_landing_shipping.chitose_chiyoda: remain seaplane tenders in branch; useful as mobile reconnaissance/maintenance support, not automatically landing carriers

landing_craft.branch_change: availability +7-12 percentage points; machinery/shaft failures -15-30%; calm-water cycle +10-15%, rough-water +3-10%; heavy equipment combat-ready 2-8h sooner
landing_craft.autumn_package_working_band: 100-130 operational landing/small craft across local stock and carried craft if preparation matures
landing_craft.warning: not all craft can use one beach simultaneously; throughput is constrained by tides, concealment, unloading points and inland distribution

initial_transport_package.purpose: one concentrated insertion, not a permanent large-merchant shuttle to Cox's

central_india_surface_package_sep1943.secondary_carriers: 0-2 base design, higher only after air-risk gate
central_india_surface_package_sep1943.first_line_carrier_rule: Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu/Soryu remain Pacific in central case
